NATIONAL SKILLS DEVELOPMENT ACT 2006

NATIONAL SKILLS DEVELOPMENT (FEES AND CHARGES)

(AMENDMENT) REGULATIONS 2023

IN exercise of the powers conferred by paragraph 72(2)(d) of the

National Skills Development Act 2006 [Act 652], the Minister makes

the following regulations:

Citation

1. These regulations may be cited as the National Skills Development

(Fees and Charges) (Amendment) Regulations 2023.

Amendment of regulation 2

2. The National Skills Development (Fees and Charges) Regulations 2016

[P.U. (A) 86/2016], which are referred to as the "principal Regulations" in these

Regulations, are amended in regulation 2 by inserting after subregulation (3)

the following subregulation—

"(4) Any person who makes an application for a search on the register

as specified in column (2) of the Fourth Schedule shall pay the fees and charges

as prescribed in column (3) of the Fourth Schedule to the Director General.".
